summary: 2026 UCI Women's WorldTour kit by Castelli, launched 17 December 2025 with an electric-lime visibility element and new partner Datashift joining on the jersey. Chest: 'AG INSURANCE' above 'SOUDAL' (co-title sponsors), with Ekopak on the viewer-left chest and a right stack holding the Specialized 'S', the UCI Women's WorldTeam badge (a UCI label, not a sponsor) and 'datashift'; safety brand Safety Jogger Works sits on both shoulders and small AG and SOUDAL logos on the collar. 'SOUDAL' bands run on the upper sleeves, 'KLEIN CONSTANTIA 1685' above the sleeve cuffs, the white AG Insurance panel wraps to the upper back, and a white 'SPECIALIZED' wordmark sits on the lower back below the rear pockets. The bib shorts carry the large 'AG INSURANCE' thigh logo and 'Ekopak' above the cuffs; Castelli scorpions appear on chest, sleeves, pockets and bib legs (kit maker, listed as partner). Not marked complete: the seat of the bib shorts and the centre of the rear pocket band are not visible in the official photos checked (team launch photo and The Wolfpack Webshop replica photos).

source.name: Footy Headlines – Al-Kholood 26-27 Home & Away Kits Released
source.quote: white Kappa Omini logos positioned on the chest and shoulders alongside the circular Al Kholood club badge
source.note: Kit supplier, listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. The launch write-up describes the whole home shirt – base colour, tonal graphic, white trim on the V-neck collar and sleeve cuffs, the Kappa Omini logos on chest and shoulders and the club badge – and nothing else: no commercial sponsor on any placement, and the launch photos show the same. The club's own store page for the players' home jersey 26/27 (https://alkholoodstore.com/products/al-kholood-fc-home-jersey-202526-2, undated, opened 2026-10-03) likewise lists the shirt's only marks: 'شعار البرج على الصدر، وشعار Kappa على الصدر والأكمام' ('the tower crest on the chest, and the Kappa logo on the chest and sleeves') plus a '1970' shield inside the collar and at the top of the back; its product photos show no sponsor logo on front or back. The Saudi Pro League's 'Fresh Fit: Kits of 2026-27 RSL' gallery (https://www.spl.com.sa/en/galleries/fresh-fits-kits-of-the-2026-27-rsl) shows the same sponsor-free shirts in its Al Kholood launch photo. Footy Headlines' article calls the deep-red zig-zag shirt the home one and the cream shirt with green raglan sleeves the away one; the club's own store and launch graphics call the cream shirt the home kit and the red one the reserve kit (الطقم الأساسي vs الطقم الاحتياطي). 433FC's pre-season table (https://433fc.com/saudi-pro-league-2026-27-shirt-sponsors/, 2026-06-15) lists 'Yelo Rent a Car' as main shirt sponsor, but it states its details 'reflect confirmed 2025/26 contracts carrying into 2026/27', and no 2026-27 shirt (launch, store or league gallery) shows any sponsor logo.

summary: Kappa home kit (the cream shirt with dark-green raglan sleeves and polo collar per the club's store; Footy Headlines' launch write-up swaps the home/reserve labels). No commercial shirt sponsor on any placement – front, back, sleeves and shorts carry only the club crest, the Kappa Omini and the 1970 collar shield – as launched in August 2026 and as sold in the club's own store.
headline: The shirt is {level}: it carries no commercial sponsors. Kappa makes the kit.

source.name: Footy Headlines: Al-Quwa Al-Jawiya 26-27 Home and Away Kits Released
source.quote: Iraqi Stars League side Al-Quwa Al-Jawiya has revealed its new home and away kits for the 26-27 season, crafted by kit supplier Kelme.
source.note: Kit maker. The launch photos on this page show the royal-blue home shirt with the Kelme paw logo on the right chest and no commercial sponsor anywhere: centre front carries the gold Iraqi Stars League champions' badge (the league's own mark, not a sponsor), the left chest the club crest, one sleeve the ISL league patch, and the shorts and socks carry only the Kelme mark. The back is not shown in the launch gallery. Kelme Iraq's own Instagram post of 12 August 2026 (instagram.com/p/Db9M_FAnDju/) announces 'طقم نادي القوة الجوية للموسم 2026-2027 من Kelme' (Al-Quwa Al-Jawiya's 2026-2027 kit from Kelme).

summary: Kelme 2026-27 home kit, royal blue with white V-neck and cuff trim. The launch photos (Footy Headlines, 14 August 2026) show no commercial sponsor on the shirt: the centre front carries the gold Iraqi Stars League champions' badge, the right chest the Kelme maker's mark, the left chest the club crest, one sleeve the ISL league patch, and plain shorts and socks with only the Kelme mark. Kelme has made the club's kits since a deal signed in July 2024 (Nakhel News/palms-news, 2024-07-06); the club plays the 2026-27 AFC Champions League Elite as Iraqi champions (IraqiNews, 2026-08-18). sponsorsComplete is false because the launch gallery does not show the back of the shirt and no announcement documents a back sponsor; in-season match imagery could not be checked from here.

summary: 2026 UCI WorldTeam kit by Kalas, revealed 1 January 2026: a return to blue, with 'Alpecin DMG SHAMPOO' above 'PREMIER TECH' across the chest and the back (Alpecin title sponsor since 2020, Premier Tech co-title partner from 2026). The right chest stack has the UCI WorldTeam badge (a UCI label, not a sponsor), Zwift, Canyon and Škoda; the left stack IKO, the Kalas logo (kit maker, listed as partner) and ABUS. Brustor and Deceuninck are on the collar, Premier Tech on the left sleeve, Alpecin DMG Shampoo on the right sleeve plus a small Alpecin patch on the left sleeve, and Canyon above the sleeve cuffs. Crelan sits on the upper back, Fenix (the brand that also names the women's team) on the lower back. The bib shorts carry Brustor across the seat, the Kalas logo on the thighs, Zwift on the front of the legs and Canyon above the hems. Marked complete: garment photos for front, back and bibs (Kalas replica pages) and 2026 race photos (Cor Vos via Domestique, kit maker's store) were all checked and match.

source.name: MotoGP.com: Aprilia Racing and Monster Energy sign a multi-year sponsorship agreement
source.quote: the presence of the iconic, three-claw logo on the factory RS-GP bikes, on the riders’ leathers, and on the team’s key assets
source.note: The quote is the second half of the sentence 'The collaboration between Aprilia Racing and Monster Energy will be highlighted by the presence of the iconic, three-claw logo...'. Announced at the Grand Prix of Italy: Monster Energy joins as main sponsor from the 2026 Italian GP and takes the title-sponsor role in 2027 (CEO Massimo Rivola: 'alongside us in 2026 as main sponsor and who will take on the role of title sponsor in 2027'). The release calls Monster Energy 'Aprilia Racing's first title sponsor', which is why the team began the 2026 season without a title sponsor.

summary: Current 2026 UCI Women's WorldTeam kit ('WeFemmes', designed by Canyon, made by new apparel partner RYZON, first raced at the Tour de France Femmes on 1 August 2026). Canyon, SRAM and Zwift cover the chest and bibs; SRAM and Zwift are also on the sleeves; kit maker RYZON's brand mark sits on the chest. zondacrypto, co-title sponsor of the 2026 'Luminous' kit raced January to May, was dropped on 29 May 2026 'following breaches of contract' (team announcement) and appears on nothing current; the UCI registration still carries the name. Scalable Capital joined on 1 August 2026 but its logo is on helmets and team vehicles only, not on the kit (team article). Checked against Ryzon's replica jersey cutouts (front/back), Canyon's official TT-suit cutouts and a TdFF Stage 1 race photo.

summary: 2026 WEC season (GMR-001 Hypercar). Factory team of Genesis, Hyundai Motor Group's luxury marque: the team name carries no commercial title sponsor, only the manufacturer's brand, and its cars run a pure manufacturer livery. Partner roster per the Hyundai Motorsport partners page and Genesis's own announcements: Shell (Official Performance & Innovation Partner, lubricants; brand on the car), Bang & Olufsen (Official Sound Partner; brand on the car sides and team clothing), Helinox (outdoor furniture), APL (footwear), Kappa (teamwear), New Era (headwear) and Racing & Emotion (licensed collectibles), plus technical partners Sparco (racewear), ORECA (chassis) and HEXIS (livery film). summary: 2026 CSL home kit by Nike, launched 28 January 2026: plain 'Liaoning red', a standard teamwear template (red shirt, black shorts, red socks). The front carries title sponsor Nanbowan (杏林楠波湾, a plastic-surgery hospital of the Xinglin medical group; naming-rights deal signed 15 December 2025) and Shengjing Department Store (盛京百货, a Shenyang municipal state retailer); the back carries Hailiang Agriculture (海粮农业) and Yunjian Equipment (云舰装备); no sleeve sponsor. Front placements are in press (the naming ceremony and Tencent/Sohu's 2026 CSL sponsor roundups). Back placements rest on a 2 March 2026 Weibo post by a Weibo-verified user showing the full kit, corroborated by the club's official partnership announcements (11 January 2026) and by Hailiang's own site; the shorts sponsor status is not documented in any source, so the list is not marked complete.

Launch date 2025-11-05; the shirt was still in use in October 2026, worn in Scotland's UEFA Nations League matches (Scottish FA match photography, 1 October 2026). Every placement checked in the launch imagery: the Scottish FA's flat product shot and Footy Headlines' studio gallery (footyheadlines.com, 2025-11-06: front, back, sleeve and shorts shots, model-worn and flat) show only the adidas performance logo and the Scotland crest on the chest, an embossed Saltire pattern across the body, a Saltire print under the back collar, plain sleeves with white cuff trim, and navy shorts carrying only the Scotland crest and adidas logo. No commercial sponsor on any placement. The shirt is sold without a front sponsor; the Scottish FA's partner list (Barclays, JD Sports, Scottish Gas etc.) are association partners, not shirt sponsors.

summary: No sponsors on the shirt: the adidas home shirt unveiled by the Scottish FA on 5 November 2025 (dark navy with an embossed Saltire pattern, still worn in the side's UEFA Nations League matches in October 2026) carries only the adidas logo and the Scotland crest; the launch photos show plain sleeves, a plain back with an under-collar Saltire print, and navy shorts with only the crest and adidas marks (Scottish FA announcement and product imagery, Footy Headlines launch gallery).

source.name: 腾讯新闻·九五体育 (Tencent News): 三大行业，成为中超球队胸前广告的赞助商

source.note: Translation: 'Zhejiang Professional Football Club's chest advertisement is Leapmotor (09863.HK)'. The article surveys all 16 CSL clubs' 2026 front-of-shirt ads after the season's opening rounds. Corroborated by the Greentown Football Archives kit-ad table (front: 零跑汽车 LEAPMOTOR) and by September 2026 match photos (zhejiangfc.com/2026/09/56880.html) showing '零跑汽车 LEAPMOTOR' across the chest. Leapmotor's 8 March 2026 announcement says it continues as Zhejiang FC's main sponsor for the 2026 CSL and FA Cup seasons.

source.quote: 绿城GREENTOWN
source.note: Continuously updated fan-run archive of Zhejiang FC's naming and shirt advertising, 1999-2026. The 2026 row reads: naming sponsor 绿城 (Greentown), front ad 零跑汽车 LEAPMOTOR, back ad 绿城GREENTOWN, sleeve ad blank. Translation: '绿城GREENTOWN' = Greentown. Corroborated by September 2026 match photos (zhejiangfc.com/2026/09/56880.html) showing '绿城 ... GREENTOWN' on the back below the number, and by the club's March 2026 announcement (via Dongqiudi) that Greentown continues as naming sponsor in 2026.

summary: 2026 CSL home kit by Nike (launched 28 January 2026). Front sponsor Leapmotor (零跑汽车 LEAPMOTOR), Zhejiang FC's main sponsor since 2024; back sponsor Greentown (绿城 GREENTOWN), the club's naming sponsor again in 2026. Sleeve advertising is blank in the Greentown Football Archives' 1999-2026 kit-ad table and no sponsor patch appears in September 2026 match photos (only the CSL league badge on the left sleeve); shorts are unbranded in the same photos.
